description: Get £220 free — the biggest switch cash around right now. Plus a 5% regular saver.
rules: Open a new HSBC Bank Account on their app (no joint accounts).
Move your old card over within 60 days with 2 regular monthly payments connected.
Pay in £2,000 and spend £500 on the card within 60 days.
exclusions: You can't claim if you've had a HSBC or First Direct current account since Jan 1, 2023.
The HSBC Basic Bank Account does not qualify.
Joint accounts do not qualify. You must live in the UK and be 18 or older.

extraRequirements: Pay at least £200 into a Santander Regular Saver held in your name within 60 days.
description: Get £240 free on a fee-free account, plus 8% interest on a linked regular saver.
rules: Open a Santander Everyday current account and start a full switch using the Current Account Switch Service.
Within 60 days: complete the switch, pay in £1,500, and have 2 active household Direct Debits.
Also pay at least £200 into a Santander Regular Saver held in your name within 60 days.
By 7 October 2026: start the switch from an account that is not Santander, cahoot or Cater Allen.
exclusions: You can't claim if you, or anyone on the account, held a Santander current account on 1 January 2026.
You can't claim if anyone named on the account has already had a Santander switch bonus.
The Direct Debits must be household bills such as council tax, energy, water, broadband, mobile, home phone or paid-for TV.
You must still hold the account and the 2 Direct Debits on the day Santander pays the bonus.
You must live in the UK.

description: Get £220 free, top customer service and a 0% overdraft.
rules: Register for the offer with your email via the First Direct link.
Within 45 days: move your old card over with 2 regular monthly payments, pay in £1,000, and make 5 card payments.
exclusions: You must never have had ANY First Direct product.
You can't claim if you've opened a HSBC current account since Jan 1, 2018.
You must live in the UK and be 18 or older.

description: Get £175 free, plus 5% interest on up to £1,500 for a year and 1% cashback for 12 months.
rules: Move your old card over with 2 regular monthly payments within 28 days.
Within 31 days: pay in £1,000 and make at least one card payment.
exclusions: You can't claim if you've had Nationwide free cash since 2021, unless switching between sole and joint.
You must live in the UK and be 18 or older.

description: Get £200 free, plus regular cashback and a 5.25% savings rate.
rules: Open a NatWest Reward account and switch in an old card with 2 regular monthly payments.
Pay in £1,250 each month to get the cashback.
Log in to the NatWest app.
exclusions: You can't claim if you've had a previous NatWest, RBS or Ulster Bank switch bonus.
You can't claim if you opened a NatWest current account on or after 6 May 2026.
You must live in the UK and be 18 or older.

description: Get £200 free when you switch to an RBS Select or Reward account. No Direct Debits needed.
rules: Open an RBS Select or Reward account.
Request a full switch using the Current Account Switch Service, closing your old account.
Within 60 days of the switch completing: pay in £1,250 and log in to the RBS mobile app.
exclusions: You can't claim if you held an RBS current account on 6 May 2026.
You can't claim if you have ever had a switch bonus from RBS, NatWest or Ulster Bank.
You can't switch from an account held with RBS, NatWest or Ulster Bank.
Student, Graduate, Foundation, Reward Black, Premier Select and Premier Reward accounts do not qualify.
Each payment must stay in the account for at least 24 hours to count towards the £1,250.
You must live in the UK.
